# Метод возвращает список тредов для mailbox holder
  def threads_for_mailbox_holder(mailbox_holder, user, filter_params)
    filter_params = prepare_filter_params_v3(filter_params)

    filters = filters(filter_params)
    email_filter = email_filter_to_and_from

    threads =
      if filter_params[:context] == CONTEXT_SENT
        Communication::MailboxHelper.folder_based_sent_threads_list(mailbox_holder, user, filters)
      else
        Communication::MailboxHelper.threads_from_emails(mailbox_holder, user, filters)
      end

    threads.map { |t| prepare_thread(t, email_filter, filter_params[:context] == CONTEXT_SENT) }.compact
  rescue Communication::MailboxHelper::InvalidCredentialError, Communication::MailboxHelper::AuthorizationError, Communication::MailboxHelper::UnauthorizedRequestError
    Communication::Mailbox::AccountInvalidateWorker.perform_async(mailbox_holder.id, user.actor.type, user.actor.id, mailbox_holder.id)
    []
  end

  # even when the entry drops, so a failed result is ignored.
  # The event is system-initiated, so the actor is built here.
  def send_event(connection, action)
    system = System.new

    Supporting::ActivityFeed::Api.send_event(
      firm: connection.firm,
      user: system.user,
      actor: system,
      type: 'integrations',
      action: action,
      object_entity: OBJECT_ENTITY,
      object_id: OBJECT_ID,
      object_name: I18n.t(OBJECT_NAME_KEY),
      audit_trail_params: {}
    )
  end

def cohort_invoice?(form)
    return false if form.invoice_id.blank?

    invoice = Billing::Invoice.find_by(external_id: form.invoice_id)
    return false if invoice.nil?

    Platform::FeatureFlags.feature_available?(:independent_billing_domain, invoice.firm)
  end

# Метод возвращает список тредов c учетом фильтров from/to
    def threads_from_emails(mailbox_holder, current_user, filters)
      emails_to = filters[:to]
      emails_from = filters[:from]
      nylas_connection = mailbox_holder.nylas_connection
      holder_email = nylas_connection.present? && nylas_connection.email.present? ? nylas_connection.email.downcase : ''

      threads = (emails_from || []).map do |email|
        fetch_threads(mailbox_holder, current_user, filters.merge(from: email.downcase))
      end.flatten

      threads += (emails_to || []).map do |email|
        sent_threads = fetch_threads(mailbox_holder, current_user, filters.merge(to: email.downcase, from: holder_email))
        cc_threads = fetch_threads(mailbox_holder, current_user, filters.except(:to).merge(cc: email.downcase, from: holder_email))
        bcc_threads = fetch_threads(mailbox_holder, current_user, filters.except(:to).merge(bcc: email.downcase, from: holder_email))
        sent_threads + cc_threads + bcc_threads
      end.flatten

      threads.uniq { |t| t[:id] }
    end

    base_scope = TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::Document.where(firm_id: firm.id).joins(:document, :tax_preparation).merge(visible_documents).preload_associations_lazily

#
  # Returns organizers available for current actor with applied filters and paginated
  #
  #
  #
  def filter(user, actor, firm, form)
    organizers = organizers_available_for_user(user, actor, firm)
    organizers = organizers.by_creator_type_in(user, form.search_params.delete(:created_by_in)) if form.search_params[:created_by_in].present?
    organizers = organizers.by_creator_type_not_in(user, form.search_params.delete(:created_by_not_in)) if form.search_params[:created_by_not_in].present?
    organizers = organizers.includes(:stage_clients) if form.includes_params.include?('stage_client_ids')
    organizers = organizers.ransack(form.search_params).result.secondary_default_sorting

    organizers.page(form.page).per(form.per)
  end

#
  # Iterate through sections and questions and gather conditions markers for each question.
  # The section markers are copied to each question inside a section to check all relations between questions.
  #
  #
  #
  def prepare_conditions_graph(template_version)
    template_version.sections.each_with_object({}) do |section, acc|
      section_display_conditions = section.display_conditions
      section_display_conditions_markers = []
      if !section.display_conditions_mode_is_off? && section_display_conditions.present? && section_display_conditions.valid?
        section_display_conditions_markers = section_display_conditions.answers.map(&:question_marker)
      end

      section.questions.each do |question|
        display_conditions = question.display_conditions

        markers = []
        markers = section_display_conditions_markers if section_display_conditions_markers.present?

        if !question.display_conditions_mode_is_off? && display_conditions.present? && display_conditions.valid?
          question_markers = display_conditions.answers.map(&:question_marker)
          markers += question_markers
        end

        acc[question.marker] = markers if markers.present?
      end
    end
  end

# Publishes the job-level `workflow.jobs` / `destroyed` event. Call inside the destroy
    # transaction, before the link rows cascade, so sync consumers still see which entities
    # the job was linked to. A job without linked entities publishes nothing: every consumer
    # reconciles from `entities`.
    #
    def publish_destroyed(job, user:, actor:)
      entities = Workflow::Pipelines::Jobs::LinkDispatcher.collect_entities(job)
      return if entities.empty?

      Platform::EventDispatcher.publish(
        idempotency_key: SecureRandom.uuid,
        firm: job.firm, user: user, actor: actor,
        topic: 'workflow.jobs', event_name: EVENT_DESTROYED, event_version: 1,
        data: {job_id: job.id, entities: entities}
      )
    end

# Метод получает список трэдов по api и фильтрует их по переданным параметрам
    def filtered_threads(mailbox_holder, filters)
      limit = filters.delete(:limit)
      amount_to_load = limit.nil? ? DEFAULT_THREAD_LIST_LIMIT : [MAX_THREAD_LIST_LIMIT, limit.to_i].min
      limit = nylas_api_limit(limit, mailbox_holder.firm)
      latest_message_before = filters.delete(:last_message_before)

      threads = []

      loop do
        loaded_threads = log('filter_threads', mailbox_holder, filters) do
          # TODO: Implement caching
          email_filters = filters.slice(:to, :from, :cc, :bcc)
          query_params = {limit: limit, latest_message_before: latest_message_before}.merge(email_filters)

          grant_id = mailbox_holder.nylas_connection.present? ? mailbox_holder.nylas_connection.nylas_grant_id : nil
          thread_list_params = {grant_id: grant_id}.merge(query_params)

          threads_with_cache(filters, mailbox_holder, limit, latest_message_before) do
            api_request { Communication::NylasClient.get_thread_list(thread_list_params) }
          end
        end

        filtered_threads = loaded_threads

        threads_to_add = filtered_threads.take(amount_to_load)
        amount_to_load -= threads_to_add.count

        if loaded_threads.last && loaded_threads.last.latest_draft_or_message
          latest_message_before = loaded_threads.last.latest_draft_or_message.date - 1
        end

        threads |= threads_to_add
        # We want to give amount_to_load threads to the frontend (currently it is 20)
        # Since we will filter out mited threads, we request more threads from the provider (50 as the maximum possible)
        # The condition for exiting the cycle is:
        # 1. We have already received the required number of threads
        # 2. We have received zero threads
        # 3. We have received less than the required number of threads. No more threads to load
        break if amount_to_load.zero? || loaded_threads.blank? || loaded_threads.count < limit || filtered_threads.count == loaded_threads.count
      end

      threads
    end

def create_reminder_schedule!(proposal, reminder_params)
    delay_days = reminder_params[:repeat_delay_days].to_i
    repeat_count = (reminder_params[:repeat_count].presence || DEFAULT_REPEAT_COUNT).to_i

    schedule_id = Platform::Schedule.create(
      SCHEDULE_TYPE, proposal.firm_id,
      args: {proposal_id: proposal.id},
      first_start_at: delay_days.days.from_now,
      delay_days: delay_days,
      repeat_count: repeat_count,
      idempotency_key: reminder_schedule_key(proposal)
    )
    proposal.update!(schedule_id: schedule_id)
  end

    def trigger_executor(user, actor, trigger, job)

    end

# Entities linked to the job, as carried by the job-level `archived` / `destroyed` events.
    #
    def collect_entities(job)
      JOB_EVENT_ENTITY_TYPES.flat_map do |entity_type|
        dispatch = ENTITY_DISPATCH.fetch(entity_type)
        job_fk = dispatch[:model].reflect_on_association(dispatch.fetch(:job_association, DEFAULT_JOB_ASSOCIATION)).foreign_key

        dispatch[:model].where(job_fk => job.id).pluck(dispatch[:fk]).map { |id| {entity_type: entity_type, entity_id: id} }
      end
    end

def get_invoice(firm:, user:, actor:, id:)
        FirmContext.with_firm(firm.id) do
          result = GettingPaid::Invoices::Get.call(user, actor, id)

          # Invoices::Get converts PolicyError into a :policy_error result reason; re-raise so
          # it propagates the same way as every other Api method.
          raise AbstractPolicy::ForbiddenAccessError if result.failed_with?(:policy_error)

          if result.failed?
            {success: false, errors: result.errors, reason: GET_INVOICE_REASON_MAP.fetch(result.reason), data: nil}
          else
            {success: true, errors: {}, data: invoice_attrs(result.data)}
          end
        end
      end

# External IDs mapping for QBO Transaction models attributes
    #
    def map_qbo_references_on_transactions_attributes(connection, transactions_attributes)
      account_qbo_ids = transactions_attributes.filter_map { |transaction| transaction[:account_qbo_id] }
      account_qbo_ids |= transactions_attributes.flat_map { |transaction| transaction[:lines_attributes].filter_map { |line| line[:account_qbo_id] } }

      customer_qbo_ids = transactions_attributes.filter_map { |transaction| transaction[:customer_qbo_id] }
      customer_qbo_ids |= transactions_attributes.flat_map { |transaction| transaction[:lines_attributes].filter_map { |line| line[:customer_qbo_id] } }

      department_qbo_ids = transactions_attributes.filter_map { |transaction| transaction[:department_qbo_id] }
      employees_qbo_ids = transactions_attributes.filter_map { |transaction| transaction[:employee_qbo_id] }
      item_qbo_ids = transactions_attributes.flat_map { |transaction| transaction[:lines_attributes].filter_map { |line| line[:item_qbo_id] } }
      transaction_class_qbo_ids = transactions_attributes.flat_map { |transaction| transaction[:lines_attributes].filter_map { |line| line[:transaction_class_qbo_id] } }
      vendor_qbo_ids = transactions_attributes.filter_map { |transaction| transaction[:vendor_qbo_id] }

      accounts = account_qbo_ids.any? ? connection.accounts.select(MAPPING_SELECT_ATTRIBUTES).where(qbo_id: account_qbo_ids) : []
      customers = customer_qbo_ids.any? ? connection.customers.select(MAPPING_SELECT_ATTRIBUTES).where(qbo_id: customer_qbo_ids) : []
      departments = department_qbo_ids.any? ? connection.departments.select(MAPPING_SELECT_ATTRIBUTES).where(qbo_id: department_qbo_ids) : []
      employees = employees_qbo_ids.any? ? connection.employees.select(MAPPING_SELECT_ATTRIBUTES).where(qbo_id: employees_qbo_ids) : []
      items = item_qbo_ids.any? ? connection.items.select(MAPPING_SELECT_ATTRIBUTES).where(qbo_id: item_qbo_ids) : []
      transaction_classes = transaction_class_qbo_ids.any? ? connection.transaction_classes.select(MAPPING_SELECT_ATTRIBUTES).where(qbo_id: transaction_class_qbo_ids) : []
      vendors = vendor_qbo_ids.any? ? connection.vendors.select(MAPPING_SELECT_ATTRIBUTES).where(qbo_id: vendor_qbo_ids) : []

      transactions_attributes.map do |transaction|
        transaction[:lines_attributes] = transaction[:lines_attributes].map do |line|
          account_id = find_inner_id_for_qbo_reference(line[:account_qbo_id], accounts)
          customer_id = find_inner_id_for_qbo_reference(line[:customer_qbo_id], customers)
          item_id = find_inner_id_for_qbo_reference(line[:item_qbo_id], items)
          transaction_class_id = find_inner_id_for_qbo_reference(line[:transaction_class_qbo_id], transaction_classes)

          line.merge(account_id:, customer_id:, item_id:, transaction_class_id:)
        end

        account_id = find_inner_id_for_qbo_reference(transaction[:account_qbo_id], accounts)
        department_id = find_inner_id_for_qbo_reference(transaction[:department_qbo_id], departments)
        customer_id = find_inner_id_for_qbo_reference(transaction[:customer_qbo_id], customers)
        vendor_id = find_inner_id_for_qbo_reference(transaction[:vendor_qbo_id], vendors)
        employee_id = find_inner_id_for_qbo_reference(transaction[:employee_qbo_id], employees)

        transaction.merge(account_id:, department_id:, customer_id:, vendor_id:, employee_id:)
      end
    end

# Invite one regular team member per address on the caller's behalf, asynchronously: the whole
      # batch goes to `Employees::BatchInviteByEmailsWorker`, best-effort — a refused address is reported
      # there and skipped (the actor's own email is only logged), so this call answers success once the
      # job is enqueued.
      #
      def send_invites(firm:, user:, actor:, emails:)
        TeamManagement::Employees::BatchInviteByEmailsWorker.perform_async(firm.id, user.id, actor.class.db_name, actor.id, emails)

        {success: true, errors: {}, reason: nil}
      end

# Declarative set-write of one client's `TeamManagement::Client::Assignment` rows: apply `added`,
      # then remove `removed` — or, with `clear: true`, everyone currently assigned.
      #
      # Removals go through `Clients::Assignments::Destroy` one assignment at a time and
      # it publishes unconditionally, so N removals emit N `batch_access_revoked` events.
      #
      #   Success data `{client_id:}`. Failures: `:not_authorized`, `:validation_error`,
      #   `:processing_error`.
      def update_account_access(firm:, user:, actor:, client_id:, added: [], removed: [], clear: false)
        raise ArgumentError, "actor.firm_id (#{actor.firm_id}) does not match firm.id (#{firm.id})" if actor.firm_id != firm.id

        result = TeamManagement::Clients::Assignments::SetForClient.call(
          user, actor, firm, client_id, added_assignments: added, removed_assignments: removed, clear:
        )
        return {success: true, errors: {}, reason: nil, data: {client_id: result.data[:client_id]}} if result.successful?

        {success: false, errors: result.errors, reason: result.reason && UPDATE_ACCOUNT_ACCESS_REASON_MAP.fetch(result.reason), data: nil}
      rescue AbstractPolicy::PolicyError => e
        {success: false, errors: {base: [e.message]}, reason: :not_authorized, data: nil}
      end

#

  #

  def users_available_for_user(user, actor, firm)
    scope = firm.users
    return scope if UserPolicy.can?(user, actor, :view_all)

    assigned_client_ids = ClientsQuery.available_for_user(user, actor, firm)

    scope.joins(:client_users).merge(Crm::ClientUser.where(client_id: assigned_client_ids))
  end

# Batched {count_with_tag}: how many distinct pipelines reference each of the given tags, over
  # both the stage-condition and the automation-condition path. A pipeline reaching the same tag
  # through repeated conditions, or through both paths at once, is counted once.
  #
  # Runs one query per path — two in total — no matter how many tags are asked for.
  #
  #   `0` for tags no pipeline references. Empty hash for empty `tag_ids`, without hitting the database.
  def counts_by_tag(firm, tag_ids)
    return {} if tag_ids.blank?

    pairs = [{pipeline_conditions: :condition_tags}, {automations: {pipeline_conditions: :condition_tags}}].flat_map do |stage_join|
      firm.pipelines.joins(stages: stage_join).where(pipeline_condition_tags: {tag_id: tag_ids}).pluck(:id, pipeline_condition_tags: :tag_id)
    end

    counts = pairs.uniq.group_by(&:last).transform_values(&:size)
    tag_ids.index_with { |id| counts[id].to_i }
  end

def get_proposal_template(firm:, user:, actor:, template_id:)
        FirmContext.with_firm(firm.id) do

            {success: false, errors: result.errors, reason: GET_PROPOSAL_TEMPLATE_REASON_MAP.fetch(result.reason), data: nil}

          end
        end
      end

# Seed a freshly created firm's default-assignment set with its owner.
      # Bootstrap-only, not a general "add a default assignee" write: the
      # internal builds exactly one row, always for `firm.owner`, and takes no
      # assignee argument.
      #
      # `errors` is forwarded verbatim from the internal, per-attribute shape
      # intact, because the caller re-raises it as its own error payload.
      #
      #   Success carries no data. Failure reasons: `:validation_error`, `:not_authorized`.
      def create_default(firm:, user:, actor:)
        # Same guard, and the same reasoning, as `Api::Subscriptions.deactivate_employee_feature`:
        # `AbstractPolicy#result` accepts System and admin before any `can_*?` runs, and neither is
        # firm-scoped (`System` has no `firm_id`; `admins` has no such column), so they are exempted
        # rather than compared. Everyone else is keyed on USER, mirroring
        # `Firm::DefaultAssignmentPolicy#firm_connection_check`'s `resource.firm_id == user.firm_id`
        # — the policy accepts an Editor and two sales-manager roles that carry no `firm_id` of
        # their own, and `Actor` has no `firm_id` at all for four of the types this contract admits.
        #
        # Answered as a failed result, not raised: the caller turns a failure into
        # `DefaultAssignmentsNotCreatedError`, which its rescue chain covers — an `ArgumentError`
        # would escape it and strand the subdomain `occupy_subdomain` has already taken.
        unless actor.system? || actor.admin? || user.firm_id == firm.id
          return {success: false, errors: {base: ['Actor does not belong to this firm']}, reason: :not_authorized}
        end

        internal = TeamManagement::Firms::DefaultAssignments::Create.call(user, actor, firm)
        return {success: true, errors: {}, reason: nil} if internal.successful?

        {success: false, errors: internal.errors, reason: :validation_error}
      rescue AbstractPolicy::PolicyError => e
        {success: false, errors: {base: [e.message]}, reason: :not_authorized}
      end

# Clones a bill (invoice) template from a source firm into the caller firm
      # (marketplace/demo clone). Wraps GettingPaid::Templates::Bill::Clone.
      #
      #   source template's name is used. Lets marketplace name the clone after the purchased product.
      def clone_invoice_template(firm:, user:, actor:, template_id:, source_firm_id:, name: nil)
        FirmContext.with_firm(firm.id) do
          template = GettingPaid::BillTemplate.where(firm_id: source_firm_id).find(template_id)
          result = GettingPaid::Templates::Bill::Clone.call(user, actor, template, name: name)

          if result.successful?
            {success: true, errors: {}, reason: nil, data: {template_id: result.data.id}}
          else
            {success: false, errors: result.errors, reason: CLONE_INVOICE_TEMPLATE_REASON_MAP.fetch(result.reason), data: nil}
          end
        end
      rescue ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound
        {success: false, errors: {}, reason: CLONE_INVOICE_TEMPLATE_REASON_MAP.fetch(:not_found), data: nil}
      end

# Returns IDs of documents (with client read-only access) that are linked to
      # the given invoices via document_locks. Used by GettingPaid payment flows to
      # notify clients about documents unlocked when invoices are paid.
      #
      # Replaces the legacy cross-cluster query:
      #   client.documents_with_client_read_only_access.unlocked_by_bills(invoices)
      #
      # Trust model: this method does NOT call TaxPreparation::DocumentPolicy.authorize! per doc
      # (unlike #find_by_ids). Tenant isolation is enforced by `@firm.clients.find(@client_id)`
      # (cross-firm probes return failure with reason `:client_not_found`) plus the
      # `client.documents_with_client_read_only_access` scope (per-document ACL).
      # Callers must hydrate results through the same ACL scope at the boundary
      # (e.g. `resource_client.documents_with_client_read_only_access.where(id: ...)`)
      # rather than `TaxPreparation::Document.where(id: ...)`.
      #
      # Guest-payment fallback: when callers pass `user: nil` or `actor: nil`
      # (e.g. guest invoice-link flows), this method substitutes `firm.owner.user`
      # / `firm.owner` so the underlying KindOfService — which requires non-nil
      # user/actor — runs uniformly.
      #
      # Failure semantics: `data` is always `Array<Item{id:, doc_dir_id:}>` (defaults
      # to `[]`) even on the `:client_not_found` failure path, so callers can chain
      # `result.data.map(&:id)` without safe-navigation. Inspect `result.success`
      # / `result.reason` to detect failure.
      #
      def find_by_invoices(firm:, user:, actor:, invoice_ids:, client_id:)
        return {success: true, errors: {}, reason: nil, data: []} if invoice_ids.blank?

        effective_user  = user  || firm.owner.user
        effective_actor = actor || firm.owner

        result = TaxPreparation::Documents::FindByInvoices.call(effective_user, effective_actor, firm, invoice_ids, client_id)
        if result.successful?
          {success: true, errors: {}, reason: nil, data: result.data}
        else
          {success: false, errors: result.errors, reason: result.reason, data: []}
        end
      end

# Returns the synchronized participant clients of a mailbox thread owned
      # by the caller's firm. Cross-firm and missing threads are reported as
      # `:thread_not_found` (we do not disclose existence of other firms' threads).
      #
      # Firm-scoped only by design (spec.md FR-007): per-actor read authorization
      # is enforced upstream by `resolve_thread`. Workflow callers invoke
      # `thread_clients` for system-level pipeline linking and do not need an
      # additional `Communication::MailboxThreadPolicy` check here.
      #
      # rubocop:disable Lint/UnusedMethodArgument -- user/actor are part of the public API contract per docs/domains_public_apis.md
      def thread_clients(firm:, user:, actor:, thread_id:)
        thread = Communication::Mailbox::Thread.where(firm_id: firm.id).find_by(id: thread_id)
        return {success: false, errors: {}, reason: :thread_not_found, data: nil} if thread.nil?

        clients_data = thread.clients.pluck(:id).map { |id| {id: id} }

        {success: true, errors: {}, reason: nil, data: {clients: clients_data}}
      end

# Assign the requested firm members to one client, or the firm's default team when the
      # caller may not pick it. The default branch serves a client with no team yet.
      #
      #   first assignee, ahead of the firm defaults
      #   A client that already has a team ⇒ `:validation_error` on the default branch
      #   unassigned when the caller may pick the team, and is ignored when it may not.
      #   Success data `{client_id:}`. Failures: `:not_authorized`, `:client_not_found`,
      #   `:validation_error`, `:processing_error`.
      def assign_with_default(firm:, user:, actor:, client_id:, assignments:)
        raise ArgumentError, "actor.firm_id (#{actor.firm_id}) does not match firm.id (#{firm.id})" if actor.firm_id != firm.id
        raise ArgumentError, "user.firm_id (#{user.firm_id}) does not match firm.id (#{firm.id})" if user.firm_id != firm.id

        result = FirmContext.with_firm(firm.id) do
          TeamManagement::Clients::Assignments::AssignWithDefault.call(user, actor, firm, client_id, assignments)
        end
        return {success: true, errors: {}, reason: nil, data: {client_id: result.data[:client_id]}} if result.successful?

        {success: false, errors: result.errors, reason: ASSIGN_WITH_DEFAULT_REASON_MAP.fetch(result.reason), data: nil}
      rescue AbstractPolicy::PolicyError => e
        {success: false, errors: {base: [e.message]}, reason: :not_authorized, data: nil}
      end

# Workflow `unfinished_requirements` rendering — entity-level payload + linked unpaid
        # invoice ids per document id. Replaces inline AR traversal
        # (`job.documents.with_pending_payment`) in `UnfinishedRequirementsHelper#find_documents_with_unpaid_bills`.
        # Returns only documents that actually have unpaid bills (`with_pending_payment` semantics).
        # Link metadata (`trigger_kind`, `linked_at`) is the caller's concern (Workflow side) — re-fetch
        # via `job.documents.where(id: returned_ids).with_pipeline_job_link_fields`.
        # Invoice details (`invoice_number`/etc.) — consumer resolves via `GettingPaid::Api::Invoicing.list_invoices`.
        #
        def list_documents_with_unpaid_bills(firm:, user:, actor:, document_ids:)
          FirmContext.with_firm(firm.id) do
            result = TaxPreparation::Documents::GetDocuments.call(user, actor, {id_in: document_ids})
            return {success: false, errors: result.errors, reason: :processing_error, data: []} if result.failed?

            documents = result.data.not_deleted
            allowed_ids = documents.ids

            unpaid_invoice_ids_by_doc_id = TaxPreparation::DocumentLock.with_unpaid_bills.
              where(document_id: allowed_ids).
              pluck(:document_id, :bill_id).
              group_by(&:first).
              transform_values { |rows| rows.map(&:last) }

            items = documents.filter_map do |doc|
              unpaid_invoice_ids = unpaid_invoice_ids_by_doc_id[doc.id]
              next if unpaid_invoice_ids.blank?

              document_unblocked_attrs(doc, unpaid_invoice_ids)
            end

            {success: true, errors: {}, data: items}
          end
        rescue AbstractPolicy::PolicyError => e
          {success: false, errors: {base: [e.message]}, reason: :not_authorized, data: []}
        end

# Creates the firm's default directory template
        # ("Default Tax Years", is_default: true). Encapsulates the default

        def create_default_directory_template(firm:, user:, actor:)

# Workflow `unfinished_requirements` rendering — entity-level signature payload per
        # document id. Replaces inline AR traversal
        # (`job.documents.not_deleted.with_pending_signature_requests.reject(&:signed?).reject(&:voided?)`)
        # in `UnfinishedRequirementsHelper#find_documents_not_signed`.
        # Returns only documents with a pending signature request that are not signed and not voided.
        # Link metadata (`trigger_kind`, `linked_at`) is the caller's concern (Workflow side) — re-fetch
        # via `job.documents.where(id: returned_ids).with_pipeline_job_link_fields`.
        #
        #   signature_request: { signature_status: }, signers: [...], user_ids: [Integer] }] }
        def list_documents_with_signature_payload(firm:, user:, actor:, document_ids:)
          FirmContext.with_firm(firm.id) do
            result = TaxPreparation::Documents::GetDocuments.call(user, actor, {id_in: document_ids})
            return {success: false, errors: result.errors, reason: :processing_error, data: []} if result.failed?

            documents = result.data.
              not_deleted.
              with_pending_signature_requests.
              lazy_preload(signature_request: [
                {created_placeholders: :signer},
                {pending_qes_requests: :signer}
              ])

            items = documents.reject(&:signed?).reject(&:voided?).map { |doc| document_signature_attrs(doc) }

            {success: true, errors: {}, data: items}
          end
        rescue AbstractPolicy::PolicyError => e
          {success: false, errors: {base: [e.message]}, reason: :not_authorized, data: []}
        end

#
  # Generates an image containing the specified text.
  #
  #
  def convert_text_to_image_tmp_file(text, font_setting, retina_multiplier: 2)
    point_size = font_setting.font_size * retina_multiplier

    TmpFileUtils.write_and_prepare_bin_tempfile(extension: 'png') do |file|
      absolute_file_path = Rails.root.join(file.path)

      MiniMagick::Tool.new('convert') do |convert|
        convert.background('transparent')
        convert.fill(font_setting.color)
        convert.pointsize(point_size)
        convert.font(font_setting.font_file_path)
        convert << "label:\\ #{text}"
        convert << absolute_file_path
      end
    end
  end

# Pending tasks split into the overdue and the still-ahead bucket, each
      # counted by priority — every priority always present, zero-filled. The
      # buckets are complements, so they never overlap; a task with no due date
      # falls into neither. The overdue bucket is never narrowed by a window:
      # a missed deadline stays visible no matter which dates are on screen.
      # The reader's visibility rule is always applied, as in `.get_stats`.
      #
      #   `firm` — `ArgumentError` otherwise
      #   empty — no assignee filter
      #   inclusive) — the window of the still-ahead bucket; omitted, `upcoming`
      #   comes back nil
      def get_overdue_stats(firm:, user:, actor:, assignees: [], counters: {})
        # Same visibility rule as `.get_stats`, so the same cross-field invariant: it is a property
        # of the actor alone, and without this an actor working under firm A reads firm B's counters.
        raise ArgumentError, "actor.firm_id (#{actor.firm_id}) does not match firm.id (#{firm.id})" if actor.firm_id != firm.id

        FirmContext.with_firm(firm.id) do
          result = Workflow::Tasks::LoadOverdueStats.call(user, actor, firm, {assignees:, counters:})

          {success: true, data: result.data}
        end
      end

      #
      # No-op when no firm user matches `user_id`, the user has no signer, or the
      # signer's email already matches. `ActiveRecord::RecordInvalid` propagates by
      # design so the caller's transaction rolls back exactly as before.
      #
      def detach_from_user(firm:, user:, actor:, user_id:)
        target = firm.users.find_by(id: user_id)
        return {success: true, errors: {}, reason: nil, data: {}} if target.blank?

# Builds the presentation data ("locals") for documents embedded in an email body.
      # Caller: Communication (mailbox_methods — email preview + render).
      # Orchestrates: firm-scoped id-load -> optional client silo filter ->
      # TaxPreparation::Documents::BatchBuildAttachedDocumentLocals.
      #
      # `client_id` is optional: the render path passes it (silo filter applied — only
      # documents whose directory the client may read survive); the preview path omits
      # it (no per-client filtering). BatchBuildAttachedDocumentLocals already returns
      # pure primitives, so nothing crosses the cluster boundary.
      #
      def build_attached_document_locals(firm:, user:, actor:, document_ids:, emails:, client_id: nil, document_link_expires_at: nil)
        documents = ::TaxPreparation::Document.includes(:doc_dir).where(firm_id: firm.id, id: document_ids)

        if client_id
          client = firm.clients.find(client_id)
          readable_dirs = client.doc_dirs.with_client_read_access
          documents = documents.select { |document| document.doc_dir.silo.in?(readable_dirs) }
        end

        result = ::TaxPreparation::Documents::BatchBuildAttachedDocumentLocals.call(
          user, actor, documents, {emails:}, {document_link_expires_at:}
        )

        if result.successful?
          {success: true, errors: {}, reason: nil, data: result.data}
        else
          {success: false, errors: result.errors, reason: :build_locals_failed, data: nil}
        end
      end

    # resolved name) — so the duplicate check never diverges from what Create saves.

    def resolve_job_name(name, client, pipeline, template, params = nil)
      return '' if name.blank?

      client.firm = pipeline.firm
      I18n.with_locale(pipeline.firm.locale) do

          ShortcodesHelper.replace_pipeline_stage_client_create_shortcodes(name, client: client, pipeline: pipeline, template: template, params: params, locale: pipeline.firm.locale).strip.gsub(/ {2,}/, ' ')

      end

      #   Create one team chat channel in the given firm with the listed participants.
      #   Note: design doc (`chats.md`) uses `skip_broadcast?` informally as a Boolean naming hint;

      #     Success: `data: { channel_id: <Integer PK> }`.
      #     Failure reasons: `:title_blank`, `:duplicate_title`, `:not_authorized`.
      def self.create_channel(firm:, user:, actor:, title:, participant_actors:, skip_broadcast: false)
        raise ::Api::Contracts::ViolationError, 'firm/user.firm mismatch' if firm.id != user.firm_id

        params = {

          user, actor, params, skip_broadcast: skip_broadcast

        failure_for(result)
      rescue ::AbstractPolicy::UnauthorizedAccessError
        failure(:not_authorized)
      end

              {success: true, errors: {}, reason: nil, data: {template_id: result.data.id}}
            else
              {success: false, errors: result.errors, reason: REASON_MAP.fetch(result.reason), data: nil}
            end
          end
        rescue ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound
          {success: false, errors: {}, reason: REASON_MAP.fetch(:not_found), data: nil}
        end

# Workflow automation guard — checks archived state for a batch of wiki pages.
  # Used by `Workflow::Pipelines::Automations::AddWikiPage::Run` to skip linking
  # archived pages without loading `Supporting::Wiki::Page` directly. Delegates
  # to `Supporting::Wiki::Pages::Get` for lookup + policy enforcement. Missing
  # pages are silently dropped from the result; a policy denial on any id
  # short-circuits the whole request.
  #
  #   reason: :not_authorized on policy denial.
  def check_archived(firm:, user:, actor:, wiki_page_ids:)
    FirmContext.with_firm(firm.id) do
      pages = []
      wiki_page_ids.each do |id|
        result = Supporting::Wiki::Pages::Get.call(user, actor, firm, id)
        if result.successful?
          pages << {id: result.data.id, archived: result.data.archived_at?}
        elsif result.reason == :not_found
          next
        else
          return {
            success: false,
            errors:  {message: result.message.to_s},
            reason:  FAILURE_REASON_MAP.fetch(result.reason),
            data:    []
          }
        end
      end

      {success: true, errors: {}, data: pages}
    end
  end

# Сохраняет участников для batch upsert тредов
  def for_batch(upsert_rows:, threads_map:, firm:, thread_email:, current_time:)
    thread_email_downcase = thread_email.to_s.downcase

    # Собираем все уникальные emails участников
    all_emails = collect_emails_from_rows(upsert_rows, thread_email_downcase)
    return if all_emails.empty?

    insert_participants(all_emails, firm.id, current_time)

    # Загрузить participant IDs
    participants_map = fetch_participants_map(all_emails, firm.id)

    # Формируем и вставляем связи thread-participant
    thread_participant_attrs = build_batch_thread_participant_attrs(
      upsert_rows, threads_map, participants_map, thread_email_downcase, current_time
    )
    return if thread_participant_attrs.empty?

    thread_participant_attrs.uniq! { |attrs| [attrs[:mailbox_thread_id], attrs[:mailbox_participant_id]] }
    Communication::Mailbox::ThreadParticipant.insert_all(
      thread_participant_attrs,
      unique_by: %i[mailbox_thread_id mailbox_participant_id],
      returning: false
    )
  end

def self.from(entitlement)
    new(
      firm_id: entitlement.firm_id,
      feature_name: entitlement.feature_name,
      enabled: true,
      starts_at: entitlement.starts_at,
      expires_at: entitlement.expires_at,
      created_at: entitlement.created_at
    )
  end

# A cancelled firm that held only a monthly term has no subscription to read, so it goes without a
  # licence period.
  #
  def call(firm)
    subscription = Subscriptions::Api::Subscriptions.firm_subscription(firm: firm).data
    started_at, expires_at = licence_period(subscription)

    {
      firm_id: firm.id,
      license_type: license_type(firm),
      yearly_licenses: subscription&.purchased_licenses_count.to_i,
      seats_on_trials: seats_on_trials(firm),
      license_started_at: started_at,
      license_expires_at: expires_at
    }
  end
